output.summary: A culinary herb in the buckwheat family, French sorrel has a tart, slightly lemony taste from oxalic acid and may become bitter later in the season. It is eaten in salads, soups and sauces, especially sauces for fish.
output.edibilityNote: Used as a culinary herb in salads, soups and sauces, especially with fish; tart from oxalic acid and sometimes bitter later in the season.
